summary: BC3/DXT5 alpha-block encoder. Quantizes 16 alpha samples to 4-bit nibbles with error diffusion and packs the nibbles MSB-first into two DWORD outputs (a1, a1+4), then delegates color-block compression to TextureFilterAndLayerCompositing.

local_names.a1: output DWORD pair for packed alpha nibbles
local_names.a2: input float4 pixel array; alpha component read at a2 + 3

operations.description: zero the 16-entry error-diffusion buffer v11 via memset
call FPUControlWordMerger() to configure the FPU control/rounding word for the quantization arithmetic
loop counter v16 is loaded from register v3 whose initialization is not visible in the decompilation; loop executes while v16 < 16, implying a start of 0
v15 = a2 + 3 selects the alpha component of each float4 pixel
iterate 16 pixels; for each accumulate v4 = error v11[v16] + current alpha sample
quantize to a 4-bit nibble: v13 = v4 * 15.0 + 0.5, nibble = (int)v13
compute residual quantization error v9 = v4 - nibble * 0.06666667 (inverse of 15)
if (v16 & 3) != 3 diffuse error right: v11[v16 + 1] += 0.4375 * v9
if v16 < 12 diffuse to the next row: v11[v16 + 4] += 0.3125 * v9; when (v16 & 3) != 0 also down-left v11[v16 + 3] += 0.1875 * v9; when (v16 & 3) != 3 also down-right v11[v16 + 5] += 0.0625 * v9
delegate color-block compression: return TextureFilterAndLayerCompositing(a2, a1 + 2 dwords, 0)
